scope: Native Mac local productivity workflows; disposable fixtures, no provider or cloud handoff acceptance

defect.trigger: Return while editing task notes in the nested pinned-note editor
defect.before: The vertical TextField submits the default Done action and closes the editor; following text is not added to the note. Reproduced with native computer use and XCTest.
defect.after: A native TextEditor inserts line breaks and keeps the editor open until Done is explicitly chosen. Existing draft binding and save/undo behavior remain.
defect.platform: Mac-owned inspector only; iOS TaskEditor has separate keyboard behavior and receives no Mac view dependency.

limitations: Runtime priority-inversion warnings remain; strict clean-runtime verifier rejects the final note result despite its passing functional case.

Runner session log records in-process symbolication following event completion. Application stdout has no corresponding QoS warning; raw stored frames are addresses without symbols, so root cause remains unproven.
Installed Desktop widgets, VoiceOver, rich cloud handoff, profile-switch and external-provider/distribution requirements remain open.

functionalChecks.navigationDrafts: Today/Inbox draft separation and restoration passed in v1; that run has warnings and other failed cases.
functionalChecks.focus: Search duplicate titles with project/section context, cancel without changing selection, start/pause/relaunch with Home context passed in v2.
functionalChecks.projectPulse: Scoped Studio selector, current progress, distinct recorded completion/reopen history and relaunch passed in v2.
functionalChecks.pinnedNotes: Newline does not dismiss editor; note edit, unpin, native Undo, pin count and edited text after relaunch passed in v3.

visualReview: Pinned note retains four readable lines, café/emoji content and the inserted edit after relaunch. Focus displays Paused, selected title/Home context and Resume/End controls. Pulse separates 1/3 current completion from 2 completion and 1 reopen events, with explicit history coverage.
